content: Bɛkɩklɩ́ɩ Yesu Nwunsʋ
Brɛ́á Yesu lósuná atɔ́ ánfɩ fɛ́ɛ́ tá á, ɔlɛbláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Mlɩyin ánɩ́ ɩlasí nkenyɔ́ bégyi Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ. Nkɛ ámʋtɔ á, ɔkʋ ɔbɔ́pʋ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ wá mɩ́ alupʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ, bɛ́da mɩ́ mántá oyikpalíhɛsʋ.”
Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Yudafɔ Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ amʋ́ ahandɛ befia igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn Kaiafa wóyítɔ́, kɩ́tá agywɩɩn ɔkpa ánɩ́ bɔ́tsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ kɩ́tá Yesu ŋáintɔ, mɔ́ mʋ.
Támɛ bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ bʋmɔ́ɔbwɛ mʋ́ nkɛ ámʋtɔ, mɛ́nɩ kpokiti mɛ́ɛda ɔmá ámʋtɔ.
Ofobí Fánfáánfán Pʋwʋ́lɩ́ Yesu
Brɛ́á Yesu bʋ Betania wúlutɔ, Simon ɔkʋá alalɔ́ ɩlɔ pɛpɛ kɩ wóyítɔ́ ɔdɛ atɔ́ gyí a,
ɔtsɩ ɔkʋ lɛ́ba mʋ wá. Ɔdɛ prɛntʋa wankláán kʋá ofobí fánfán ánɩ́ ɩbʋ bíá bɔ mʋ́, ɔlɛtsɛɩ́ ofobí ámʋ wʋ́lɩ́ Yesu nwuntɔ.
Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ benya ɔblɔ́ brɛ́á bowun ɩ́nɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ ɔtsɩ ánfɩ layíntá ofobí fánfán ánfɩ?
Abɛ́talɩ́ fɛ́ mʋ́ ibíá kpékplé, pʋ́ kɔ́ba amʋ há ahiánfɔ.”
Yesu lɛ́bɩ ánɩ́ ɔblɔ́ lakɩ́tá amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩdɛ́ mʋ háan? Ɩtɔ yilé alabwɛ́ há mɩ́.
Ahiánfɔ bétsiá mlɩtɔ ekekegyíɛkɛ, támɛ mɩ́ mʋ́ mméetsiá mlɩ wá yɔ́.
Alatsɛ́ɩ́ ofobí fánfán ánfɩ wʋ́lɩ́ mɩ́, pʋ́lá mɩ́ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ yáɩ́ há mɩ́ opulákɛ́.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ɔtɩ́nɛgyíɔtɩ́nɛ́á bɛ́da Bulu asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan a, bɛ́blɩ́ tɔ́ ánfɩ ɔtsɩ ánfɩ labwɛ́ ánfɩ pʋ́káɩ́n mʋsʋ.”
Yuda Iskariot Lótsulá Ánɩ́ Ɔbɛ́lɛ Yesu Há
Mʋ́ ɔma a, mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Yuda Iskariot lɔ́yɔ Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ wá.
Ɔlɛyɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ nɛlɛ́ Yesu há mlɩ á, ntɔ mlɛ́ha mɩ́?” Mʋ́ sʋ bɛkla sika futútú adʋasa (30) wá mʋ ɩbɩtɔ.
Tsú brɛ́ ámʋtɔ ɔlɔwa ɔkpa dunká ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́tsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ lɛ́ Yesu há amʋ́.
Katsʋn Atogyihɛ Gyí
Israelfɔ Bodobodo Mátúhɛ́Nkɛ ámʋtɔ ɛkɛ gyankpapʋ a, akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛba Yesu wá bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíé, obu mɔmʋtɔ ayɛla ha fʋ, afʋgyi Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ atogyihɛ amʋ?”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyɔ asímasi wá wúlutɔ, amlɩyɛbláa mʋ mlɩaa, ‘Osunápʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mɩ́ brɛ́ lafʋn. Ɩ́nɩ sʋ mɩ́a mɩ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ abá begyi Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ ámʋ fʋ́ wóyítɔ́.’ ”
Mʋ́ sʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɔyɔ́bwɛ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ámʋ pɛ́pɛ́ɛ́pɛ́. Bɛla obu ámʋtɔ, bwɛ́ Katsʋn Nkɛtɔ atogyihɛ amʋ yáɩ́ ɩnʋ.
Brɛ́á nsaɩntɔ deklúun a, Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bɛba betsiá ɔpʋ́nʋ́ ámʋ asɩ.
Atɔ́ ámʋ ogyíkpá a, Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa, mlɩtɔ ɔkʋlɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há.”
Asʋ́n ánfɩ lɛ́hɩɛ han akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ befi asɩ bʋdɛ mʋ fɩtɛ́ kʋlɛkʋlɛ bɛɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, mɩ́ nɩ́ lóó?”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ mɩ́a mʋnyɔ anɩdɛ́ ɩbɩ wa ɔlɛpɛ ɔkʋlɛtɔ ámʋ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há.
Mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nówu fɛ́ alɩá bɔwanlɩ́n tswɩ́ɩ, támɛ ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há ámʋ ɔgyɔ́wɩ nɩ́. Nɩ́ bʋmetepí kwɩ́ɩ́ mʋ kʋ́ráá á, tɛkɩ ɩbʋ alɛ́ há mʋ.”
Yuda Iskariot amʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛlɛ mʋ há ámʋ ɛ́ lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́, mɩ́ nɩ́ lóó?” Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ee, fablɩ́.”
Yesu Ntʋ́pwɛ Atogyihɛ Tráhɛ
Brɛ́á bʋdɛ atɔ́ ámʋ gyí a, Yesu lɛ́lɛ bodobodo ipín, ɔlɛda Bulu ɩpán, bíábía mʋ́tɔ́ pʋ́há mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩhɔ amlɩgyi. Mɩ́ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ nɩ.”
Ɩnʋ olotsu ntá-ɛwɛ, ɔlɛda Bulu ɩpán, pʋ́há amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩhɔ amlɩnu.
Mɩ́ obugya nɩ. Mʋ́ Bulu dɛ́pʋsí mʋ ntam
ánɩ́ alaká há ahásʋ nɩ́. Bɛ́tsɛɩ́ mʋ́ wʋ́lɩ́ asɩ, mɛ́nɩ obési ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ lakpan kíé amʋ́.
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, mmɛ́ɛtrá nu wáɩn-abí ntá ánfɩ alɩɩ yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá mɩ́a mlɩnyɔ abɛ́lanu mʋ́ pɔ́pwɛ mɩ́ Sɩ́ iwíegyí ámʋtɔ.”
Benya wá ɩlʋ dá Bulu ɩpán tá alɩ, bɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ Nfɔ-nyíbʋ ámʋsʋ.
Petro Ɔbɔ́swɩɩ́ Ɔbɛ́ɛ Mʋmeyín Yesu

Brɛ́á bowie Nfɔ-nyíbʋ ámʋsʋ á, Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ “Mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ mléyinkí mɩ́ ɔma onyenɩ. Tsúfɛ́ bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ bɛɛ, ‘Nɛ́da akúfa ɔkpapʋ́ ámʋ lɛ́dá, mʋ akúfa bɛ́dasáɩ́n.’ ”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛtrá blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Támɛ nɩ́ Bulu ɔkʋ́sʋ́a mɩ tsú afúlitɔ á, négya mlɩ nkpá yɔ́ Galilea ɔmátɔ́. Ɩnʋ mlɔ́bɔtʋ mɩ́ nɩ́.”
Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ beyinkí fʋ́ ɔma kʋ́ráá á, mɩ́ mʋ́ mméeyinkí ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ fʋ́ bláa. Onyenɩ, asa batɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ ɔnɔ́ á, fɔ́swɩɩ́ pʋ́ ɩbɩ wá ogyá tse sa fɛɛ fʋmeyín mɩ́.”
Ɩnʋ Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ lowu ígyi kʋ́ráá á, mméekiná fʋ́ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.” Alɩ kɛ́n akasɩ́pʋ́ atráhɛ amʋ ɛ́ bɛblɩ́ nɩ́.
Mpáɩbɔ Getsemane
Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bɔyɔ ɔtɩnɛkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ ɩnʋ Getsemane. Brɛ́á bowie ɩnʋ á, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩtsia nfɩ, nɔyɔ́ nkpá yɔ́bɔ mpáɩ.”
Ɔlɛkpa Sebedeo abi anyɔ, bʋgyi Yakobo mʋa mʋ pio Yohane pʋ́ Petro ya. Ɩnʋ asʋ́n lɛhɩɛ́ han mʋ, mʋ ansɩ́ lɛpɛ.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Asʋ́n ɩhɩ́ɛ́ dɛ mɩ́ háan, ideklé ɩmɔ mɩ́. Mlɩtsia nfɩ, mɩ́a mlɩnyɔ agyo.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ nkpá kpalobí, ɔlɛda akpawunu pʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́ bun ɔsʋlʋ́tɔ, kókóli Bulu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Sɩ́, nɩ́ ɩbɔ́wa alɛ́ á, ha ntá-ɛwɛ ánfɩ
ɩtsʋn mɩsʋ. Támɛ megyí tɔ́á ndeklé, mboún mʋ́á fʋdeklé ɩbá mʋ́tɔ́.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ oleyinkí ba akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ wá bowun ánɩ́ bʋdɛdɩdɩ. Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ Petro ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩmɛ́talɩ́ tsíá, mɩ́a mlɩnyɔ agyo dɔnhwɩ́rɩ kʋlɛ kpán?
Mlɩgyo amlɩkokoli Bulu, mɛ́nɩ mlɩmóowie ɩsɔ́kɩtɔ, tsúfɛ́ mlɩ ɔŋɛ́ deklé, támɛ nyankpʋsa-oyí lɔpɔn.”
Yesu lɛ́trá yókokóli Bulu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Sɩ́, nɩ́ ntá-ɛwɛ ánfɩ mɔ́ɔtsʋn mɩsʋ, ɩbwɛ́ alɩágyíalɩ́á nónu mʋ́ á, mʋ́mʋ́ tɔ́á fʋdeklé ɩbá mʋ́tɔ́.”
Ɔlɛtrá yinkí ba bowun ánɩ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bʋtráa bʋdɛdɩdɩ, tsúfɛ́ dɩdɩ́ dɛ amʋ́ bʋ.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛnatɩ́ sí amʋ́, trá yókokóli Bulu otse saasɩ, blɩ́ asʋ́n ámʋ kɛ́n.
Oleyinkí ba akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ wá, bɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩlatráa si mlɩda mlɩdɛ́ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ da? Mlɩkɩ, brɛ́ ámʋ lafʋn ánɩ́ bɔ́pʋ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ wá lakpan abwɛpʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ.
Mlɩkʋsʋ ayɔ. Mlɩkɩ, ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔdɛ mɩ́ lɛ há ámʋ ná á.”
Yesu Kɩtá
Yesu ɔnɔ́ mesi asa akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Yuda lóbowie ɩnʋ. Ɔdɔm kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩá bʋdɛ ndayí pʋ́ nkpotí bʋbuo mʋ. Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ lɔ́wa amʋ́.
Yuda amʋ́ʋ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ Yesu há ámʋ lɛ́bláa ɔdɔm amʋ yáɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ nɛ́latá pútá ámʋ gyí ɔhá ámʋ nɩ. Mlɩkɩta mʋ.”
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔlɛnatɩ́ laa yɛ́ha Yesu itsiá ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́, tsia nɩ́!” Ɔlɛlatá mʋ pútá.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Agya, bwɛ tɔ́á ɔbwɛkpá fɛba.” Ɩnʋ ahá ámʋ bɛnatɩ́ tʋ́ Yesu, kɩ́tá mʋ kínkíínkín.
Ɩnʋ Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛ lɔ́tswɩ mʋ ɔdayí, kpá Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn osúmbi ɔkʋ ɩsʋ lɛ́.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Yinkia fʋ́ ɔdayí wa mʋ́ ɔflɛtɔ. Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔtɛnátɩ́ kɩ́tá ɔdayí á, ɔdayí ɔnɔ́ otesin.
Fʋmeyín fɛɛ nɛ́talɩ́ kókóli mɩ́ Sɩ́ ɔbɛ́ha mʋ abɔpʋ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ akú dúanyɔ bɛ́ba bɔkɔ hɔ mɩ?
Támɛ nɩ́ ɩbá alɩ á, nkálɩ ɩbɔ́bwɛ asa Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ ɩbɛ́ba mʋ́tɔ́?”
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ogyo otswapʋ́ ngyi, sʋ́ mlɩlatsú nkpotí pʋ́ ndayí mlɛbá mɩ́ ɔkɩtákpá? Ntsie mlɩ wá Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa ɩnʋ ekekegyíɛkɛ ndɛ mlɩ atɔ́ suná, mlɩmɛ́kɩtá mɩ́ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.
Támɛ ɩ́nɩ fɛ́ɛ́ laba mʋ́tɔ́, mɛ́nɩ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ asʋ́n wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ ɩbɛ́ba mʋ́tɔ́.” Ɩnʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛsrɩ́ sí mʋ.
Yudafɔ Ahandɛ Ansɩ́tɔ́ Lɩɩ́
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu akɩtápʋ́ amʋ bɛkpa mʋ ya Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn Kaiafa. Ɩnʋ́ mʋa Mose mbla asunápʋ́ pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ befia nɩ.
Támɛ Petro lɛ́pɛtɩ́ obuo amʋ́ ɔma tsútsúútsú alɩɩ bowie igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn wóyítɔ́ ɩnʋ. Oleyétsiá amʋ́ agyópʋ wá, mɛ́nɩ obówun alɩá asʋ́n ámʋ ɩbɔ́mɔ ɔnɔ́.
Ɩnʋ Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ mʋa Yudafɔ asʋ́n agyípʋ́ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bodunká ahá ánɩ́ bɛ́ka asʋ́n dɩ́nká Yesusʋ, mɛ́nɩ bɛ́lɩɩ́ mʋ́sʋ́ mɔ́ mʋ.
Afunupʋ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɛdalɩ ba, támɛ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ ɔnɔ́ lɔtsʋn ɔtsan. Mʋ́ ɔma a, ahá abanyɔ́ bɛdalɩ bɛlɩɩ́ ahandɛ amʋ ansɩ́tɔ́,
blɩ́ bɛɛ, “Oyin ánfɩ lɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Nɛ́talɩ́ bwíé Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa amʋ, lápʋ́ nkɛnsá yi mʋ́.’ ”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ lɔ́kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ fɩ́tɛ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋma ɔnɔ́ lɛ́? Fʋma asʋansʋ blɩ́ pʋ́lɛ́ fʋ́ ɩwɩ?”
Támɛ Yesu móbwií ɔnɔ́. Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ lɛ́labláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɛká Bulu Ɔkɩankpapʋ amʋ, nɩ́ fʋ́gyí Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli), ogyi Bulu mʋ Bi ámʋ a, bláa anɩ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mʋ́ fablɩ́ á. Támɛ mlɩbɩ ánɩ́ tsú ndɛ pʋ́ya a, mlówun mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ntsie Bulu Otúmípʋ gyɔpɩsʋ ánfɩ, ndɩn ɔsʋ́sʋ́ nwʋlʋ́táasʋ nɛbá.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ lɛ́kɩtá mʋ atadɩɛ bálɩ́ mʋ́ kɩaan,
blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ “Alabɔ́ mbusuo! Adánsɩɛ mɔmʋ anɩtráa anɩgyó? Yɛ́ɛ mlɩlanú abususʋ ánɩ́ alablɩ́.
Nkálɩ gyí mlɩ agywɩɩn?” Bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Ilehián ánɩ́ obówu!”
Ɩnʋ botutúu atsʋnɔ́ wʋlɩ́ mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́, wɔwɔ mʋ atswɛ. Akʋ ɛ́ bɛdadáa mʋ asʋtɔ,
fɩ́tɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Kristo, ma ládá fʋ́? Bla anɩ.”
Petro Lɔ́swɩɩ́ Ɔbɛ́ɛ Mʋmeyín Yesu
Petro tsie wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ, otsibi ɔkʋ lɔ́bɔtʋ mʋ. Ɔlɛbláa Petro ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́a Yesu Galileayin amʋ nyɔ ná.”
Támɛ Petro lɔ́wa ɔnɔlɩ́ ahá ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ ansɩ́tɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mmeyín asʋ́n ánfɩ fʋdɛblɩ́ ánfɩ ɩwɩ kʋkʋʋkʋ.”
Mʋ́ ɔma wóyí ɔnɔ́ ɩnʋ ɛ́ á, otsibi ɔkʋ ɛ́ lɛ́bɩ Petro. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛbláa ahá ánɩ́ bʋlɩɩ́ ɩnʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Oyin ánfɩ mʋa Yesu Nasaretyin amʋnyɔ tɛ́nátɩ́.”
Ɩnʋ Petro lɔ́pʋ ɔnɔlɩ́ ká ntam, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mmeyín mʋ.”
Mʋ́ ɔma a, ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋlɩɩ́ ɩnʋ ámʋtɔ akʋ bɛba bɛbláa Petro bɛɛ, “Lɛ́lɛ́ mʋ́ á, anɩyin ánɩ́ fʋ́a Yesunyɔ ná, tsúfɛ́ fʋ́ tɔ́ɩtɔ dɛ anɩ suná alɩ.”
Ɩnʋ Petro lɔ́wa ntam kakáa bɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɛká tógyítɔ́, mmeyín oyin ámʋ́ʋ́ mlɩdɛ́ mʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n blɩ́ ámʋ!” Ɩnʋnʋ batɛ lɔ́bɔn.
Petro lɛ́kaɩ́n ánɩ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fɔ́swɩɩ́ tse sa fɛɛ fʋmeyín mɩ́ asa batɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ ɔnɔ́.” Ɩnʋ ɔlɛdalɩ hɩ́ɛ́ yósu.
